entities.name: Photosystem I subunit IX (Q85V00)
observations: Exact 44-aa sequence match to reviewed Larix decidua UniProt Q85V00, annotated as photosystem I reaction center subunit IX.
Annotation: may help organize PsaE and PsaF subunits; localized to plastid chloroplast thylakoid membrane as a single-pass membrane protein.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular weight 4,974.851 Da, pI 4.557, GRAVY 0.9409; Pfam PSI_PsaJ (PF01701.24) at residues 1–37.
